description: Check whether this MCP server can prepare private Papex research drafts, provide bounded proposal-only draft assistance and reference lookups, prepare external contextual Artifact references, place private Artifact file packages in quarantine, seal a hash under a separate seal grant, or record hidden content checkpoints under a separate checkpoint grant. Seal and checkpoint authority signs only a private hash commitment as DELEGATE; it does not sign a research record or confirm human authorship. A checkpoint additionally makes no claim; its only label is the short folder name the owner set in PAPEX_CHECKPOINT_NAMES, if any, never the path. Assistance cannot save, accept, sign, or publish. Artifact scopes remain prepare-only and cannot sign, accept or reject, choose rights, release, suppress, embargo, download public files, publish, or issue a DOI. If setup is incomplete, returns the canonical Workspace connection URL.
name: papex_setup_delegation
title: Check Papex delegated research connection
